reachability: pipeline builder -> runBuilderAttempt -> chatCompletionStream, selected user provider key via getUserProviderKey
black-hole/providerAdapter.complete and completeStream forward to the same functions
benchmarkExecutor callback has optional authorize hook, direct execution when absent remains explicit upstream admission obligation
dataOwnership: Model transport receives message arrays and an optional credentialOverride string, not an issued tenant context, project proof or reservation handle. Ownership and provider credential provenance remain upstream proof obligations.
classification: Prompts may contain USER_PRIVATE, BUSINESS_CONFIDENTIAL and PERSONAL_DATA. The new shared credential floor rejects recognized secret values or the selected provider credential in outgoing text before either SDK call. This is not universal DLP, image-content inspection or complete egressPolicy admission.
destinationControl: resolveEndpoint chooses fixed server registry endpoints and enforces coding transport policy. clientFor now admits public HTTPS syntax. It does not pin SDK DNS or control provider-internal image fetching. No request body supplies a base URL.
accountSelection: credentialOverride or getSecret selects actual provider credential. Lower layer cannot prove caller's vault identity from a raw string, so it remains unresolved rather than automatically safe.
budget: Known architect/converter wrappers reserve and settle through existing withProviderReservation. No lower-layer universal reservation proof is inferred. Optional benchmark authority and guest/black-hole paths need separate bounded tracing.
authority: No tool/model text can mint a permit. This patch does not introduce a second authority or budget ledger and does not claim canonical egressPolicy coverage for every model caller.
next: Carry existing issued tenant, actual account/vault and reservation identity to this canonical boundary without breaking legitimate guest or benchmark admission. Prove at the actual upstream call sites before final disposition.
